nome_articolo: Cartoon Kingdom Grendizer King Bust 1/4 Duke Fleed (Statua)
descrizione:
Grendizer Bust of Duke Fleed, 1/4 scale size approx.23cm. Official product in limited edition of 800 pieces by Cartoon Kingdom.

King Bust is a premium 1/4 scale bust line with integrated decor, showcasing each character through detailed staging, exceptional craftsmanship, and a striking representation of the upper half of the hero.

A new license joins this line, featuring Actarus from the legendary universe of Goldorak.

An immersive decor inspired by his battle to protect Earth, combining technological elements and a cosmic atmosphere to capture the nobility, determination, and power of the Prince of Euphor.

23x21x14cm
